name: The Harvest Bride
source:
The apple harvest is in full swing and everybody in the village knows what that means: the Harvest Festival is right around the corner! And as the daughter of the mayor, you are here to make sure all preparations run seamlessly! 

Help the villagers fulfill not only their assigned tasks but also with some personal problems. 

Hopefully, you’ll still have enough time to make a certain village boy fall for you...

And who knows, you might even get chosen as the Harvest Bride!

.

..

…

But is that actually something you want? 

[From [url=https://nemuatisto.itch.io/the-harvest-bride]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
苹果的收获正如火如荼地进行，村里的每个人都知道这意味着什么：丰收节即将来临！作为市长的女儿，你来这里是为了确保所有准备工作顺利进行！

帮助村民不仅完成分配的任务，还解决一些个人问题。

希望你还有足够的时间让某个乡村男孩爱上你……

谁知道呢，你甚至可能被选为丰收新娘！。

..

……

但这真的是你想要的吗？

[来自[url=https://nemuatisto.itch.io/the-harvest-bride]itch.io[/url]]
